title: Academic Writing for University
subject: Academic Writing
description_short: This course covers academic argument, thesis, evidence, structure, APA citation, paraphrasing, and revision. It is for university students who need to write clear, well-sourced academic essays.
outcomes: formulate a focused, arguable thesis that previews the essay's reasons
support subclaims with credible evidence and analysis
structure body paragraphs around subclaims rather than source order
apply APA 7th edition citation rules and write correct reference entries
paraphrase accurately and revise essays by checking thesis, evidence, structure, and sources
